ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Cobalt Strike DNS Beaconing - Sysmon
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a program that invoked suspicious DNS queries known from Cobalt Strike beacons Note: Unmapped fields: QueryName

sequences.query: ((QueryName = RGX("^aaa\\\.stage\\\.") OR QueryName = RGX("^post\\\.1")) OR QueryName = RGX(".*\\\.stage\\\.123456\\\..*"))
